fbactors.tip1: Press R to start an actor take at the playhead. Perform, press R again, and the take plays back as a clone
fbactors.tip2: Record another take while earlier actors play back to stage chases and fights one pass at a time
fbactors.tip3: Hits on actors replay as hurt animations at any point on the timeline. Scrubbing never breaks a fight
fbactors.tip4: Dress a take after recording: emotes, gear loadouts, morphs and skins never touch the performance
fbactors.tip5: Drag a take's clip body to move it, its edges to trim. Trimming never deletes frames
fbactors.tip6: Use /actor bundle export to share the whole cast with a collaborator
fbactors.tip7: Escape finishes a run only at the end of footage. Use Stop recording to finish earlier.
